items:
A 
 work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmets shoes, gloves, etc
Isolate the circuit breaker of the pump motor.
Disconnect electric terminals of the pump motor.

The
 pump must be isolated mechanically by 
 closing delivery and suction valves.

Be sure pump must be completely 
 drainage.

Measure vibrations level for 
 bearings and compare it with the setting value, then analyze it and determine 
 what to do (if it is needed).

Check discharge quantity and 
 pressure and compare them with the setting value then replace the worn- out 
 components (if it is needed).

Check alignment and compare it with 
 the setting value.

Check bolts fixation, then 
 re-tightens it (if it is needed).

Check the validity of oil and add or 
 change it (if it is needed).

Check glands for leaking and 
 re-packing (if it is needed).

Check the pump casing against rust 
 and re-paint (if it is needed).

Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the 
equipment Inspection list I1, which must be performed every six months as 
indicated by M6 in the above title block.
The first draft initiated 
by eng Medhat Foaad, tested at 03 June 2003, revised by EDEPC quality 
control eng. Abouda Elbana, accepted by general 
manager eng Ali Mostafa El_Lithy and Approved by Mostafa Alaam Talkha PS Head 
Sector.
Safety Precautions
A 
 work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmets shoes, gloves, etc
Isolate the circuit breaker of the pump motor.
Disconnect electric terminals of the pump motor.
The
 pump must be isolated mechanically by 
 closing delivery and suction valves.
Be sure pump must be completely 
 drainage.
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid.Manual 
puller.
Feeler 
gauge, 
 Dial 
indicator
Vibrometer, 
Straight edge, 
 Rags.

Cleaning fluid.Manual 
puller.
Feeler 
gauge, 
 Dial 
indicator
Vibrometer, 
Straight edge, 
 Rags.
Work to be carried out
Pump in Service
Measure vibrations level for 
 bearings and compare it with the setting value, then analyze it and determine 
 what to do (if it is needed).
Check discharge quantity and 
 pressure and compare them with the setting value then replace the worn- out 
 components (if it is needed).
Pump out of service
Check alignment and compare it with 
 the setting value.
Check bolts fixation, then 
 re-tightens it (if it is needed).
Check the validity of oil and add or 
 change it (if it is needed).
Check glands for leaking and 
 re-packing (if it is needed).
Check flanges for leaking.
Check the pump casing against rust 
 and re-paint (if it is needed).
